# Running Authnd Locally

Codespaces are the paved path for authnd development.  For most non-trivial e2e testing, a Dotcom codespace with authnd bootstrapped to your development branch is the best choice.

Local development for authnd is supported on a _best effort_ basis by members of the team.

Please file an issue and/or reach out to us in the [#authentication](https://github.slack.com/archives/C01B991MG3H) channel in Slack!
